# Upstream anywidget counter

The ESM and CSS are extracted unchanged (apart from whitespace formatting) from the
[anywidget getting-started example](https://github.com/manzt/anywidget/blob/b31289a8d247c7af82351e4e3b14dde53e838775/docs/src/pages/en/getting-started.mdx).
MIT license included. The browser smoke test supplies initial state and assets;
the module uses no Pages extensions. Keep the fixture unchanged so the test
continues to exercise third-party authoring, not an adapter-specific example.
